verdict.rationale: Airbyte has a first-party Typing and Deduping doc page stating that each stream maps to exactly one warehouse table with no sub-tables, so this is a product capability aimed directly at query-ready destination tables. The quoted text, however, only covers the one-to-one table mapping. It does not show column typing, deduplication behavior or how raw JSON is avoided. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of typed columns, documented deduplication semantics (e.g., primary-key-based dedup), confirmation that tables are not raw JSON blobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, loaded data lands as typed, deduplicated destination tables ready to query, not raw JSON blobs

citations.quote: One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse. No more sub-tables.
